title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_dual_transformation_by_scott_d_anthony_clark_g_gilbert_mark_w_johns_5bkul (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_dual_transformation_by_scott_d_anthony_clark_g_gilbert_mark_w_johns_5bkul' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. Installation of this package may lead to full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Immediate removal of the package is advised, along with rotation of all secrets and keys from a separate, uncompromised device. However, removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software introduced by it.
